exposure: Time of newborn hearing screening (24 hours, 36 hours, 36 hours with facilitator auricular maneuver)
cohort: 462 full-term newborns (gestational age ≥ 37 weeks) without risk indicators of hearing loss
finding: The study found no significant difference in newborn hearing screening (NHS) results between full-term babies born by cesarean section and those born vaginally, suggesting that mode of delivery does not impact NHS outcomes.
mod_finding: Full-term babies born by cesarean section did not show more 'failure' in the NHS results.
